description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_FarmingBot" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Bragging message"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DefineDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseSharing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SharingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Finished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bot" name="Farming bot"/>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateBot" name="Create a custom farming bot"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select desired resources"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define tool and resource dependencies"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Farming"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources (up to 10 in parallel)"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Farming"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Farming" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_2" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="EndEvent_Farming"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update the farming list" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_UpdateList" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEvent_UpdateList">
            <bpmn:condition id="Condition_UpdateList"><bpmn:formalExpression>A player requests an update to the farming list</bpmn:formalExpression></bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update the list of materials to farm"/>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyUpdatedList" name="Apply the updated farming list"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdateList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_2" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_ApplyUpdatedList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_3" sourceRef="Task_ApplyUpdatedList" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdateList"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Disaster" name="Handle a natural disaster" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Disaster" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEvent_Disaster">
            <bpmn:condition id="Condition_Disaster"><bpmn:formalExpression>A random natural disaster strikes</bpmn:formalExpression></bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply the disaster setback to the bot"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Disaster"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Disaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_2" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="EndEvent_Disaster"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify player of milestones" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Milestone" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEvent_Milestone">
            <bpmn:condition id="Condition_Milestone"><bpmn:formalExpression>A farming milestone is reached</bpmn:formalExpression></bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of the milestone"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Milestone"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_2" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_Milestone"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSharing" name="Choose post-farming actions"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingSplit" name="Select sharing actions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingJoin" name="Join selected sharing actions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Finished" name="Farming bot finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_3" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_4" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_5" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Task_ChooseSharing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_6" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSharing" targetRef="Gateway_SharingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Share_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Bragging is selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Share_Materials" name="Send materials" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Sending materials is selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Share_None" name="No sharing" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingSplit" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Neither sharing action is selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_End" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Finished"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Bragging message" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
